It is invoked by Test.main and serves as the shared abstraction for collaborating components in the system. OggCompressionCodec is a public Codec implementation that represents the OGG compression type. Its sole field identifies the codec as "ogg". No additional collaborators or explicit design-pattern role were captured in static analysis beyond its participation as a codec component.

MPEG4CompressionCodec is a public Codec implementation representing an MPEG-4 compression codec. Its primary responsibility is to provide the mp4 type identifier, collaborating with the Codec abstraction. No explicit design-pattern role was captured in static analysis.

BitrateReader is a public utility in the facade structure that provides static read and convert operations for video processing. It collaborates with VideoFile and Codec, and is invoked by VideoConversionFacade.convertVideo, supporting the subsystem hidden behind the facade pattern.

Button is a public interface defining two UI actions: rendering and click handling. HtmlButton is a concrete Button implementation that handles HTML button rendering and click behavior through overridden render() and onClick() methods. It collaborates with Button clients via incoming render calls and outgoing click handling, and it fits a Factory Method design-pattern context.

TextWindowState is a public memento object that stores a text snapshot in its private `text` field and exposes it through `getText()`. It collaborates with text-bearing originator and caretaker code by preserving state for later restoration, and it participates in the Memento design pattern.

EventManager is a public coordinator for event subscriptions and notifications, maintaining a map of event types to EventListener lists and collaborating with File objects during dispatch. EventListener is a public interface defining the callback contract for receiving event updates tied to a String eventType and a File. Editor is a public class responsible for file-related actions through an EventManager collaborator and a File field. It provides operations to open a file by path and save the current file. No explicit design-pattern role was captured in static analysis.

LogOpenListener is a public listener that stores a log File and reacts to update(String, File) notifications from event sources. It collaborates with File and EventListener, and static analysis identifies it in observer and visitor pattern contexts as an event-handling participant.

Monitor is a ComputerPart element that participates in the Visitor pattern. It collaborates with ComputerPartVisitor through its accept method, delegating to visit for external operations. The class represents a concrete part in the object structure and relies on visitor-based double dispatch.

Mouse is a public ComputerPart that serves as a concrete element in the Visitor pattern. It collaborates with ComputerPartVisitor through its overridden accept method, which delegates to visit, enabling visitor-defined operations on the mouse without embedding those operations in the class.

ComputerPartDisplayVisitor is a public visitor implementation that defines visit operations for Computer, Mouse, Keyboard, and Monitor. Test is a public entry-point class that drives execution through its main method. It collaborates with ComputerPart by invoking accept, serving as a simple client for the object structure. No explicit design-pattern role was captured in static analysis.

Keyboard is a public ComputerPart element in a Visitor pattern implementation. It collaborates with ComputerPartVisitor through its accept method, which delegates to visit, enabling external operations to be performed on the keyboard without embedding those behaviors in the class itself.

Computer represents a composite computer part that delegates visitor processing to a `ComputerPartVisitor`. ComputerPartVisitor is a visitor-pattern interface that defines visit operations for Computer, Mouse, Keyboard, and Monitor. It collaborates with the corresponding accept methods in those classes, providing a common double-dispatch contract for traversing computer parts.

SavepointManager is a public interface for managing transaction savepoints, defining operations to create, roll back to, and release a savepoint object. It collaborates with savepoint instances and supports transactional control. No explicit design-pattern role was captured in the static analysis.

AbstractTransactionStatus is an abstract TransactionStatus implementation that tracks rollback and completion state and manages a held savepoint. It collaborates with savepoint-related operations through getSavepointManager, setSavepoint, and getSavepoint. Static analysis captured no explicit design-pattern role beyond status management and savepoint coordination.

ApplicationEventPublisher is a public interface that defines event publication responsibilities for Spring components. It collaborates with ApplicationEvent and generic Object event payloads through two publishEvent methods. No explicit design-pattern role was captured in static analysis, though it serves as an event-publishing abstraction.

ApplicationListener is a public event-listener interface that receives application events from EventListener-based collaborators through onApplicationEvent. It also exposes supportsAsyncExecution for execution policy and a static forPayload factory that adapts a Consumer to PayloadApplicationEvent handling. No explicit design-pattern role was captured in analysis.

AbstractApplicationEventMulticaster is an abstract `ApplicationEventMulticaster` that manages application listeners and listener-bean registration/removal, using `DefaultListenerRetriever`, cached retrievers, `ConfigurableBeanFactory`, and a bean class loader. It also implements `BeanClassLoaderAware` and `BeanFactoryAware`; no explicit design-pattern role was captured.

SmartInitializingSingleton is a public callback interface for beans that need logic after all singleton beans are instantiated. Its sole collaborator is the container invoking afterSingletonsInstantiated(). No explicit design-pattern role was captured in static analysis.

DefaultSingletonBeanRegistry is a public singleton-registry base class that manages singleton objects, early references, factories, callbacks, and dependency tracking using concurrent maps and a lock. It collaborates with ObjectFactory and Consumer, extends SimpleAliasRegistry, and implements SingletonBeanRegistry; no explicit design-pattern role was captured.

SingletonSupplier implements Supplier<T> to provide a lazily initialized singleton value. It collaborates with an instance supplier, a default supplier, and a ReentrantLock to manage initialization state safely. It also offers static factory methods and an obtain accessor; no explicit design-pattern role was captured.

SingletonBeanRegistry defines a contract for registering and retrieving singleton objects by bean name, checking their presence, listing names, counting them, and adding callbacks. It collaborates with String, Object, String[], int, and Consumer<Object>. No explicit design-pattern role was captured in static analysis.

BeanDefinitionVisitor traverses a BeanDefinition and its nested values, resolving strings through a StringValueResolver collaborator. It visits parent, class, factory, scope, and collection-related elements, recursively handling arrays, lists, sets, and maps. The class serves as a visitor for bean-definition structure, with no explicit design-pattern metadata captured.

BeanFactory is a public interface that defines access to beans by name or type, including provider-based lookup and bean-name utilities. It collaborates with ObjectProvider and type parameters to support retrieval operations. Static analysis captured no explicit design-pattern role.
